references.matching_note: The relative dimension is taken for a finite-type commutative ring map.
q varies over prime ideals of S.
The global relative dimension is the supremum of indexed local fibre dimensions.

references.disposition: This is the usual order-theoretic least upper bound of the local dimensions, not a separate mathematical meaning.

review_rationale: Read the global relative ring-map dimension as supremum of local dimensions at prime points of Spec(S), with correct finite-type convention.
